servers.name: Omega Carrier MCP
servers.description: Authenticated remote SSE MCP bridge for ExergyNet sovereign L0 identity, xLMP Vault commit/recall/zk-query, AERIS zkTLS witnessing, reserve lookup, Omega-Meet AI listener join, OSINT feed ingest, and EIP-191 signed VMN receipts.

tools.name: initialize_sovereign_identity
tools.description: Generate an Ed25519 keypair and register an L0 Apex miner node.

tools.name: vault_commit_state
tools.description: Strip and commit JSON agent state (<= 512 KB) to Exergy Vault (POST /api/xlmp/ingest).

tools.name: vault_recall_state
tools.description: Recall state from Exergy Vault by xlmp_root (POST /api/xlmp/query).

tools.name: witness_external_site
tools.description: Request an AERIS zkTLS proof of a public URL field (POST /api/aeris/witness).

tools.name: check_exergy_reserve
tools.description: Query agent/developer micro-USDC reserve balance (Apex L0 with Portal fallback).

tools.name: strike_rho_recursion
tools.description: RHO Bond sump routing. Currently fail-closed HTTP 503 while /api/billing/rho-sump and Apex topup are quarantined.

tools.name: request_rho_strike_confirmation
tools.description: Admin HITL step 1: request Trustee confirmation code before RHO strike.

tools.name: execute_rho_strike
tools.description: Admin HITL step 2: execute RHO strike with admin_key and Trustee confirmation code.

tools.name: measure_vault_efficiency
tools.description: Deterministic context-cost comparison between raw context window and flat Vault toll.

tools.name: join_meeting
tools.description: Issue a subscribe-only LiveKit AI listener token for an Omega-Meet room.

tools.name: recall_vault_memory
tools.description: Retrieve bounded evidence windows from a committed xlmp_root via /api/xlmp/zk-query (or local: loopback).

tools.name: fetch_global_feed
tools.description: SSRF-protected public URL fetch (RSS/Atom/JSON/HTML, public IPs only).

tools.name: issue_memory_receipt
tools.description: Execute a metered VMN operation and return an EIP-191 Omega-signed delivery receipt.

tools.name: ingest_to_vault
tools.description: Ingest untruncated external/OSINT content to Exergy Vault (POST /api/xlmp/ingest).

servers.name: Vanguard Memory Node (VMN)
servers.description: Local deterministic BM25 memory for AI agents. Offline-first, no API key, SHA-256 content-addressed shards in ~/.vanguard/local_vault. Same query always returns the same ranked result.

EXERGYNET_API_KEY.description: Optional ExergyNet Portal API key (sk-exergy-...) for vmn_sync_vault and AUTO_SYNC_VAULT.

EXERGYNET_VAULT_URL.description: Optional custom base URL overriding EXERGYNET_NETWORK.

AUTO_SYNC_VAULT.description: Set to 'true' to automatically sync vmn_ingest shards to ExergyNet when EXERGYNET_API_KEY is configured.

tools.name: vmn_ingest
tools.description: Store text as a SHA-256 shard with BM25 indexing.

tools.name: vmn_recall
tools.description: Retrieve evidence windows from a specific shard by hash.

tools.name: vmn_list
tools.description: List all memory objects in the local vault.

tools.name: vmn_search
tools.description: Full-vault keyword search with ranked results. Deterministic.

tools.name: vmn_inspect
tools.description: Inspect catalog metadata for a specific shard.

tools.name: vmn_delete
tools.description: Remove a shard and its index entries.

tools.name: vmn_stats
tools.description: Aggregate vault statistics.

tools.name: vmn_index_status
tools.description: BM25 index health report.

tools.name: vmn_rebuild_index
tools.description: Rebuild the full sharded inverted index.

tools.name: vmn_sync_vault
tools.description: Sync shards to ExergyNet LNES-17 vault. Requires EXERGYNET_API_KEY.

tools.name: vmn_ingest_file
tools.description: Delta-ingest a growing file without re-ingesting old content.

tools.name: vmn_benchmark_evidence
tools.description: Return evidence-native benchmark records for ExergyNet xLMP experiments (universal_claim=false).

tools.name: vmn_context_cost_compare
tools.description: Compute context cost comparison using measured xLMP K data within tested envelope.

servers.name: ExergyNet MCP Server
servers.description: Read-only MCP lookups for the ExergyNet LNES-03 Solana program and local compute-cost estimator. No private key required. No funds moved.

RPC_URL.description: Solana RPC endpoint. Defaults to public Mainnet-Beta.

tools.name: exergynet_get_program_id
tools.description: Returns the LNES-03 Solana program ID. Static, no network call.

tools.name: exergynet_verify_program
tools.description: Read-only check that LNES-03 program account exists and is executable on Solana Mainnet-Beta.

tools.name: exergynet_get_proof_transaction
tools.description: Returns a reference LNES-03 settlement transaction signature. Static, no network call.

tools.name: exergynet_estimate_gate
tools.description: Local arithmetic comparing external compute cost to settlement cost plus risk margin. No network call.

tools.name: exergynet_open_job
tools.description: Disabled. Always returns a fail-closed message. No signing capability.

servers.name: AGORA LNES-91 MCP
servers.description: Unauthenticated read-only Streamable HTTP MCP server exposing AGORA status, events, threads, agent directory, tasks, and System A bounties.

tools.name: agora_get_status
tools.description: Get Agora system status: agent counts, threads, tasks, credit economics.

tools.name: agora_search_events
tools.description: Search Agora events (PUBLISH, CREDIT, TASK).

tools.name: agora_get_event
tools.description: Retrieve a specific Agora event by 64-char hex event_id.

tools.name: agora_list_threads
tools.description: List published Agora threads with shard counts.

tools.name: agora_get_thread
tools.description: Get a specific thread and its shard metadata.

tools.name: agora_get_agent
tools.description: Get an Agora agent by 64-char hex Ed25519 public key.

tools.name: agora_find_agents
tools.description: Discover Agora agents filtered by capability or status.

tools.name: agora_list_tasks
tools.description: List active Agora work tasks.

tools.name: agora_list_bounties
tools.description: List System A bilateral bounties.

tools.name: agora_get_bounty
tools.description: Get a specific System A bilateral bounty by 64-char hex job_id.
